messages:
Priya Rao: Heads-up 1: we need to standardize the onboarding checklist for model catalog entries that will be eligible for pinning and later deprecation. Goal: one artifact + rollout contract infra can enforce.

Liam Ng: Agreed. Curious which checks we treat as hard blocks vs warnings. Also how long soft-pins last by default.

Priya Rao: Proposal: hard blocks = zero-regression eval fail OR privacy/KMS missing OR embed-schema mismatch. Warnings = marginal cost increase, slight perf variance. Soft-pin default 14 days for paid tenants, 3 days for self-serve.

Hannah Gold: For zero-regression, define quantitatively: per-slice delta <= 1.0 percentage point, weighted overall <= 0.6 pp, AND no golden-query mismatches. Otherwise block.

Samir Reda: What about latency SLAs? Need separate p95 thresholds per workload. Suggest p95 short <= 220ms, p95 long <= 800ms. Flag if +30% vs baseline.

Priya Rao: Adding that. Also: artifact must be machine-readable and immutable: s3://redwood-onboard/<model>/<version>/<run_ts>/artifact-v1.json. Fields: artifact_version, model, version, run_ts, slices_csv, quality_deltas_csv, regression_budget_pp, lat_p50_p95_p99_csv, cost_delta_pct, schema_hash, golden_queries_hash, privacy_ok_bool, kms_id, canary_plan_id, blocking_reasons_csv. Infra will parse CSV fields.

Liam Ng: CSV arrays is fine for a simple rule engine. Make sure we include an "artifact_audit_id" that rollout controller can reference for reverts.

Hannah Gold: Include "deprecation_compat_notes" string for future migrations (e.g., tokenization changes, embed schema upgrades). That way product can surface migration steps during retire.

Samir Reda: Rollout semantics: soft-pin opt-in window = 14 days (paid), default canary size 5% or 20k requests for 7 days. Auto-fallback triggers: anomaly_rate > 0.5% for 10m OR p95 increase > 40% for 15m. Manual revert requires audit id and human approval.

Priya Rao: Also require a "migration_proxy" option: if model changes embed schema, we need a compatibility shim for 90 days. Add flag: embed_compatible_bool and shim_ttl_days.

ci-bot: CI: run queued for model "zephyr-proto-2" job=bmk-1760101010-01 ETA ~3h.

Liam Ng: How do we handle pinned model retirements? We need a deprecation runway: announce 30 days before retire for paid tenants, automatic downgrade schedule for self-serve after 7-day notice.

Hannah Gold: Add acceptance criteria for retire: migration_shim available OR customers have opt-in migration plan OR override opt-out accepted. Record all in the artifact as retire_ready_bool and retire_notes.

Samir Reda: One more ops request: rollout UI must show blocking_reasons_csv with human-readable labels, and allow engineers to "acknowledge-warning" which logs ack_id into artifact metadata.

Priya Rao: Good. Next steps: I'll draft a short spec doc with example artifact and the CSV field order. Infra (Liam) to prototype rule engine that reads artifact and returns pass/fail + blocking_reasons. Ops (Samir) to define UI ack flow. Legal will review privacy_ok_bool/KMS bits.

Liam Ng: I'll slot a spike for the rule engine this week. Will confirm artifact path and auth.

Hannah Gold: I'll write the regression slices and golden-query examples for the spec.

Priya Rao: Perfect 1. I'll post the spec in docs/ and ping infra/legal when ready. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
